title: Restocking Percentage and Reconditioning Parts — PAP Therapy Equipment Refunds
content:
# Restocking Percentage and Reconditioning Parts — PAP Therapy Equipment Refunds

**Prerequisite.** No restocking percentage is set on the refund until the return inspection on the device record shows the reconditioning parts amount. Put the other way, while the device record shows no return inspection with its reconditioning parts amount, the refund carries no restocking percentage yet.

**Pricing table.** The restocking percentage on the refund of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit follows the reconditioning parts amount on the return inspection:

| Reconditioning parts amount on the return inspection | Restocking percentage |
|---|---|
| 40.00 USD or more | the class's restocking percentage plus 5 percentage points |
| 10.00 USD or more but under 40.00 USD | the class's restocking percentage plus 2.5 percentage points |
| under 10.00 USD | the class's restocking percentage |

The class's restocking percentage is the self-pay restocking percentage of the device class. The restocking fee is taken at the resulting percentage and rounded half up to the cent.

**Where the parts amount is read.** The return inspection is the inspection job in the device's service history that carries no repair cost assignment; its reconditioning parts amount is the parts figure on that job.

## Resulting percentages

| Class restocking percentage | Parts 40.00 or more | Parts 10.00 to under 40.00 | Parts under 10.00 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 | 20 | 17.5 | 15 |
| 20 | 25 | 22.5 | 20 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical amounts).** Parts of 39.99 add 2.5 points; 40.00 adds 5. Parts of 9.99 add nothing; 10.00 adds 2.5.
